data.text:
**scale proof**
$16B run-rate, 100M+ subscribers, 77M+ renewals, 140+ currencies per recurly.com homepage.
**problem mechanism**
Failed transactions/churn needing intelligent retries, and manual error-prone RevRec work per homepage (uncertain if current pain).
**cost evidence**
No dollar cost found on homepage; only story of cutting close from three days to one (uncertain value).
**counter-evidence**
Homepage claims automated recovery, ASC-606 compliance, ERP/CRM integrations, Compass AI already.
**wedge fit**
Uncertain – they sell billing/data platform themselves, no clear single external data problem evidenced.
**verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no)**
No.
**why**
Scale is large but no evidenced costly mechanism from their domain to justify paid fix.
